entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A song of David.>> Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee], That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, Oh God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:

entries.title: Psalms 65:6
segments: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 65:10
segments: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.
